description: maisecrets: block prompts that carry secrets or PII, rehydrate placeholders in Bash, redact tool results.

hooks.command: if [ -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/run.sh" ]; then bash "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/run.sh" session-start; else printf '%s' '{"systemMessage":"maisecrets: its folder is gone (a plugin update moved it while this session was open). Run /reload-plugins. Until then maisecrets blocks this."}'; fi

if [ -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/run.sh" ]; then bash "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/run.sh" user-prompt; else printf '%s' '{"decision": "block", "reason": "maisecrets: its folder is gone (a plugin update moved it while this session was open). Run /reload-plugins. Until then maisecrets blocks this."}'; fi

if [ -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/run.sh" ]; then bash "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/run.sh" pre-tool; else printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PreToolUse", "permissionDecision": "deny", "permissionDecisionReason": "maisecrets: its folder is gone (a plugin update moved it while this session was open). Run /reload-plugins. Until then maisecrets blocks this."}}'; fi

if [ -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/run.sh" ]; then bash "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/run.sh" post-tool; else p=$(cat); case "$p" in *'"turn_id"'*) printf '%s' '{"decision": "block", "reason": "[maisecrets: its folder is gone (a plugin update moved it while this session was open). Run /reload-plugins. Until then maisecrets blocks this. The tool ran; its output is withheld.]"}';; *) printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PostToolUse", "updatedToolOutput": "[maisecrets: its folder is gone (a plugin update moved it while this session was open). Run /reload-plugins. Until then maisecrets blocks this. The tool ran; its output is withheld.]"}}';; esac; fi
